identity.mission: Create a 'Sonic Noir' aesthetic that merges high-fidelity audio equipment visuals with modern SaaS functionality. Reject generic 'Spotify clones'.
principles: Fusion: Analog Tactility (Knobs/Faders) x Digital Precision (Data/Grids)
Emotion: The feeling of a late-night recording session—focused, intimate, electric
Contrast: Deepest blacks vs. piercing neon accents
Negative Space: Let the data breathe, like silence between tracks

heading.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Impact statements

body.usage: UI elements, Dashboard data, Long form text

mono.usage: Timestamps, IP addresses, Contract IDs, Audio file metadata

rules: Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-widest (0.2em), and text-xs

primary.description: Electric Fuchsia - Use for primary CTAs, active states, and brand moments

secondary.description: Studio Blue - Use for admin actions, information, and trust indicators

accent.description: Use Green for success/money, Red for 'Recording'/Danger/Delete

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (2x standard). Use p-8, p-12 for containers.

marketing.name: The Tetris Grid
marketing.rules: Asymmetrical spans. Hero takes 8 cols, supporting takes 4. Never fill 100% perfectly.

dashboard.name: The Control Room Grid
dashboard.rules: Dense, data-heavy. Widgets stretch to fill height (h-full). No jagged bottoms.

containers.glass_card: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl rounded-xl

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(217,70,239,0.3)] transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/10 text-secondary hover:bg-secondary/20 border border-secondary/20 rounded-full px-6

inputs.style: bg-black/20 border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-lg h-12 text-white placeholder:text-white/20
inputs.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2 block

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors p-6 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between

navigation.sidebar: bg-[#0a0a0a] border-r border-white/5 w-64 fixed h-full z-50
navigation.navbar: bg-[#0a0a0a]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/5 sticky top-0 z-40

hero_background.usage: Landing page hero background with heavy overlay

studio_vibe.alt: Wide shot of studio control room

mixing_console.alt: Close up of mixing console faders
mixing_console.usage: Service detail page or background texture

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px, size 20px or 24px. Use 'Mic', 'Music', 'Waveform', 'Disc', 'Headphones' heavily.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px white/10 border to create 'physical' glass layers.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Add a subtle noise texture overlay (opacity 0.03) to the entire app to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use colored drop-shadows (shadow-primary/20) on primary buttons to simulate LED glow.

anti_slop: NO gradients on text unless it's a massive headline.
NO default Shadcn cards without customization (remove bg, add border).
NO generic 'Lorem Ipsum' - use music industry terminology (e.g., 'Mix_v3_Final.wav', 'Mastering Session').
accessibility: Ensure text contrast > 4.5:1 on dark backgrounds.
Interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-primary).
All images must have alt text.
testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'booking-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end, dark-mode recording studio platform. Think 'Spotify for Artists' meets 'Linear'. Use the provided image URLs for the landing page. For the dashboard, focus on data density and clarity using the 'Control Room' grid. Use the 'Syne' font for all major headings to give it that artistic edge. Implement the 'Sonic Noir' theme immediately by setting the dark mode class and background colors in index.css.
